description:
Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base; 10 signed-wallet free calls shared over rolling 30 days. Read the backend 402 body for x402 terms. Itemize caller-supplied USD estimates and calculate a total for supported computations.
Operating boundary: Supply computation items and your USD estimates. Read the itemized total. An agent carries the estimate into its work plan; a human compares the items before requesting a provider checkout.
POST /api/unified-agent-checkout. Existing product credentials, signed mandates, and single-use action grants remain required where applicable. This adapter grants no authority and never supplies server credentials. This current operation is a bounded computation on caller-supplied data.
name: wever_unified-agent-checkout
title: Unified Agent Checkout
